    "chunk_summary": "DCAT 3 §10.2 closes spatial-coverage examples (geometry/centroid/bbox in WKT, CRS84 default per GeoSPARQL, EPSG:28992 variant) and §11 opens versioning: version as a generic revision relationship, DCAT building on PAV/DCTERMS/OWL2/ADMS, versioning applicable to all first-class DCAT resources, and DCAT deliberately declining to rule on when a new version is warranted."
